title: Mark 11 Confirmed Media Destinations, Privacy-Safe Preview Cards, and TMM Media UX Optimization

partA_phaseShiftRecord.ownerConfirmation: All eight Mark 10 rendered destinations are authorized source destinations and may remain in the TMM media index.

partB_confirmationStatusVocabulary.owner-authorized-handle-derived: The owner authorized a source label/handle and the URL was mechanically derived from it under a documented platform URL rule (the Mark 10 starting state).
partB_confirmationStatusVocabulary.owner-confirmed-source-destination: The owner has reviewed this specific destination and confirms it belongs in the static index — not a claim the URL string itself was independently re-verified.
partB_confirmationStatusVocabulary.owner-supplied-canonical-url: The owner directly supplied the canonical URL (not derived from a handle). Not used by any current record.
partB_confirmationStatusVocabulary.owner-confirmed-canonical-url: The owner has reviewed and confirmed the exact canonical URL string. Not used by any current record.

partC_whatConfirmationDoesNotMean: Does not mean platform verification of the account.
Does not mean the account is currently active, live, or publishing.
Does not mean content rights for any specific item are cleared.
Does not mean automatic TMI/TMM/AVM cross-attribution — crossAttributionStatus stays prohibited-pending-per-item-approval on every record.
Does not mean any individual media item is approved for display — gates G-M1 through G-M8 remain unmet.

components: src/components/media/MediaCard.astro (upgraded in place — now one card per confirmed destination, not per record)
src/components/media/MediaPreviewArt.astro (new — local inline SVG + typographic monogram, source-class tinted)
src/components/media/MediaStatus.astro (rewritten — 3 short boundary lines per destination, not a record-level jargon list)
src/components/media/MediaGrid.astro (updated — renders ConfirmedDestination[] instead of collection entries)
partD_previewCardDesign.visualPreviewMethod: Local inline SVG geometry (frame + two rule lines) plus a typographic monogram derived from the source label, tinted per source class using this site's own --compression/--tension accent tokens. No platform logo, remote thumbnail, fake video frame, fake post grid, or fake metric.
partD_previewCardDesign.linkLabelConvention: Descriptive, e.g. 'Texas Movement Media on YouTube' — never 'Click here', 'Watch', 'Follow', or 'Subscribe'.
partD_previewCardDesign.accessibleNewTabContext: A visually-hidden '(opens in a new tab)' span accompanies every outbound link.

partE_linkGateBehavior.recordLevelGate: linkMode === 'destination-index' AND status !== 'placeholder' AND publicDisplayStatus === 'approved-static-index' AND ownerApprovalStatus === 'approved-static-index'
partE_linkGateBehavior.defenseInDepth: MediaCard.astro re-checks isSafeHttpUrl(url) before rendering an anchor.
partE_linkGateBehavior.failingDestinationBehavior: Renders nothing at all — no card, no link, no inert text (changed from Mark 10, where a failing destination rendered visible inert text inside its parent record's multi-link card).

partG_exclusions.reason: No confirmed URL slug in local evidence; scripts/check-public-output.mjs also hard-fails on any linkedin.com string. Entry retained in JSON with url:null, urlStatus:inert-missing-evidence, no confirmationStatus, for owner audit trail only.
No Facebook URL slug in local evidence; guessing one from a display name is prohibited. Same audit-trail retention as LinkedIn.
Strictly out of scope per explicit task instruction. No HERO record, destination, preview, product, or storefront link exists anywhere in the media collection.

partH_unresolvedIndividualMediaItemRequi: Gates G-M1 through G-M8 (docs/internal/mark-8-tmm-unified-media-feed-architecture.md Part D) remain unmet.
No intake template has been completed for any real item.
Owner final authorization (ownerApprovalStatus, non-delegable per G-M8) has not occurred for any individual item.
editorialStatus/rightsStatus/transcriptStatus/publicationDateStatus unchanged on every record this pass.

partI_validation.checkConstants: 0 errors (pre-existing unrelated drift warnings only, unchanged)
partI_validation.testA11y: 0 axe-core violations across all 13 routes including /media
partI_validation.manualDistInspection: Exactly 8 .media-card elements and 8 outbound links matching the 8 confirmed destinations, each with target=_blank and rel=noopener noreferrer. Zero linkedin.com/facebook.com/HERO strings. Zero new

partJ_explicitNonActions: No embed, API call, RSS fetch, scraper, or OAuth flow added.
No Cloudflare, DNS, domain, or deployment setting changed.
No merge, deploy, or publish occurred.
No non-media route's content or posture changed.
ownerReminder: After this phase completes, review every owner-confirmed source destination (see docs/internal/mark-11-media-source-confirmation-and-review.md) and correct any outdated URL, handle, classification, or relationship before any future individual-media-item phase begins.
